findings.summary: Display-name cancellation leaks character profile changes.
Keyboard/global and toolbar/local history differ; Ctrl+K and follower insertion bypass consistent snapshots; no-op history can destroy redo.
Multi-selection is cosmetic while actions use a single path; page changes retain stale positional paths.
Context-menu Escape ownership and disposal are incorrect.
Page validation target IDs and active views fail to identify the actual condition controls.
Template side effects need the event draft transaction boundary.
Shop UI festival, closingSale and vip values fail real serialize-to-deserialize round trips.
Null M2 fields are accepted at load and then throw at runtime.
Selectable changeLifeSkillExp, spawnFieldEnemy and despawnFieldEnemy commands have header-only parameter forms.
Malformed numeric text body and string wait ms survive loading.
Record picker keyboard order differs from visible map-used grouping.
Usage hints count JSON substring occurrences rather than semantic references.
Stale reference cards can be blank.
Preview simplifies loops, goto and calls. Disclose its limits; a full runtime redesign is not automatically required.
Setter callbacks and subdialog Cancel are not bugs without a violated transaction contract.
